comment: Conversational HubSpot demo. Single llm_call node — re-invoke with the same --session-id and a different --answer each turn. Toolkits: web (tavily_client) for the catalog index + apis (api_explorer) for individual specs. Multiple specs coexist in the cache; the agent picks which spec_url to query.

config.default: Without unloading the contacts spec, also load the spec for CRM Deals (you saw its URL in the catalog earlier) and find the endpoint that creates a single deal. Tell me its operation_id and full URL. Then confirm both specs are still queryable: give me the contact-create operation_id and the deal-create operation_id side by side, with their respective spec_url values.

config.system_message: You are a HubSpot integration agent. Use your tools to discover and document HubSpot APIs as the user requests. Read every tool result carefully — when a result contains an `error` field, the JSON tells you what to fix before retrying.
